name: Skyball
description: A cross between football, soccer, and dodge ball. The purpose of the sport is to have one Caster. Someone who throws the ball to great lengths to get it in one of two goals. The Catcher is someone who receives the ball and tries to make it into the opposite goal. If the ball is out of bound. Then the opposing team wins. Its rules are like football. Although how it is played is like soccer. If someone is hit by the ball in the process of it going toward a goal. Then they are immediately out which is like dodge ball. An average game can last up to 45minutes to an hour per match. 5 scores win the game. The game can be played in the air or on the ground however, playing it in the air causes it to be considered a real game and is more traditional.

name: Ghost Play
description: A game set in a closed off corridor. The goal is to capture up to 5 ghosts using a Ghost Snatcher. The team with the most ghost wins by the time the buzzer sounds. The losing team then must remain in the corridor up to one night haunted by the ghosts they caught.

name: Dragon Taming
description: A vicious sport known for the odds of someone getting hurt while playing. The goal is to tame a fierce dragon using various techniques.

name: Dragon Riding
description: Owning its history to King Arthur of the Roundtable. This sport can be one of the most dangerous sports of them all. The only rule is to win the race against up to 6 other racers.

name: Lotta Spada
description: An Italian game of sword dueling. Using magically protected armor. Giant blades are used to duel each other. The one left standing is the winner.

name: Spell Dueling
description: Using magical cards with monsters sealed within them. Often played by teenagers and young adults. This sport has grown into a dangerous yet frilled game of strength. Using energy by the duelist. The duelist would summon a creature from a spell card and battle his or her opponent until all the opponent’s creatures are defeated. The winner then takes the losers remaining energy. Enough to knock the person unconscious.

name: Mind Astra
description: A unique game meant only for mentals. This game allows players to enter a preset course inside of the player’s mind. It can be viewed through Holo Screens using focused magic pinpoints. Using any number of ways to challenge the players. The game can shift easily and often. The only rule is to not die. Using their mental strength as weapons. The player can summon anything and do anything to win. It is recommended because of the possibility of death. That only mature players are allowed. Except for Kendo Lazaron who became the youngest player to ever enter by the hands of a horsemen who wanted him dead.

name: Anakari
description: Every generation an individual is born with a unique ability or unique way of using their ability that is known as an Anakari. The name Anakari loosely translates as “unique” in ancient Elitsyian.

name: Realm
description: Unlike a universe which is self-contained in a revolving space. A realm is an endless flow of space that has no beginning nor end but exists within in its own reality separated from another. Some of the top realms, are Heaven, The Underworld, Realm of the Living, Hell, Eternity, Dream Realm, Shadow Realm, and Eden.

name: Dimension
description: Is a space consisting of compacted energy. Many dimensions serve as a place of residency for its creator or a storage place. Because its consisting of energy, dimensions can only stay in existence based on the energy flow of its creator.

name: Universe
description: A self-contained place with planets, stars, and other cosmic bodies. Now, there are an infinite number of Universes making up the multiverse. Universes typically are far from one another, and it could be impossible to travel between them. However, some universes are so close to one another that they can make up their own small multiverse. All universes exist in the Realm of Living.

name: Mage
description: A being capable of controlling and manipulating the energy that flows throughout everything.

name: Witch
description: Can manipulate magic by calling forth things with a spell or incantation. More powerful witches can use their magic without spells. Sub-races of witches are Voodoo Witches, Illusionist, and Magicians.

name: Djinns
description: Often called a Genie in disrespect. These beings are the most powerful mages, they can manipulate reality around them. If ever capture, they can grant any wish.

name: Hunter
description: A magicless mage, they are immortal, have enhanced senses, speed, and intelligence. They have sub-races which includes Vampire Slayers, Werewolf Hunters, etc.

name: Fairies
description:
Also known as: Fair folk

Are magical beings or creatures that controls nature and can change their sizes for various purposes.

name: Sorcerers
description: Powerful elementals that can control Fire, Water, Wind, Earth, Light, and Darkness. Their sub-races include Elementals which can control one element at a time and the Wizard which has Bezerk magic and must use special objects like wands to control their magic.

name: Druid
description: A mage that can heal any whom and even bring someone back from the dead. Their sub-races include Oracles, healers, prophets, shamans, and seers.

name: Shadow Fiend
description: Another type of mage that practices dark magic and shadow magic. Their sub-race can include any shadow creature like vampire, werewolf, Boogeyman, shadows, etc.

name: Magic
description: A source of energy that can be manipulated, control, created, or destroyed by a being known as a mage. Magic comes in various smaller varieties but by default is neutral.

name: Dark Magic
description: Originally created by Tonik, this form of magic is popular amongst those who need assistance from darker forces than the neutral way of performing magic.

name: Ancestral Magic
description: A powerful form of magic that calls on the historical significance of a mages’ family magic. The longer the mages’ family line, the more powerful the magic.

name: Blood Magic
description: Created by the first Blood Witch as she followed the words and teachings of Tonik. This form of magic is primarily used by using the users’ blood to enhance their own magic. Because it is performed with blood, it is more precise and stronger than normal magic. But also, it is lethal if used constantly.

name: Ranks of Authority in Tier
description: In Tier, there are eight ranks of power and control to make up its overall system of authority.

name: 1st Rank
description: The most powerful authorities figure in their jurisdiction. i.e., = High Council

name: 2nd Rank
description: Typically works for or under the 1st Rank. They are the ones who send out the commands, orders, or jobs of the 1st Rank.

name: 3rd Rank
description: Usually captains, leaders, etc that work directly beneath or next to the 2nd Rank.

name: 4th Rank
description: The everyday authority figure that has no control over anyone but act as a balance between others below them.

name: 5th Rank
description: Usually in command of their direct subordinates.

name: 6th Rank
description: Workers with enough respect to be respected by the public but not by others above them.

name: 7th Rank
description: Ground patrol like policeman and lower-level authorities’ figures.

name: 8th Rank
description: No real authority but can act on behalf of a 7th Rank in their absence. This rank usually are blue collar people.

name: Alpha Rank
description: Basic level of whose powers typically are limited to their bodies and own physical strength.

name: Beta Rank
description: Second level with their powers usually capable of hurting another individual to great degree. Most superpowered beings are at or can easily surpass this level.

name: Gamma Rank
description: Third level of whose abilities can level an entire London sized city. The Lazaron siblings become this rank during the fifth season of their story.

name: Delta Rank
description: Fourth level of where individuals can control their nearby space to some degree. Kendo Lazaron becomes this rank when possessed by the Akuma.

name: Zeta Rank
description: Fifth level of whose abilities are worldwide strong. They were worshipped as gods in ancient times.

name: Eta Rank
description: Sixth level where an individual’s powers could possibly destroy a world. This level is the level of most higher-ranking gods and Djins.

name: Theta Rank
description: Seventh level of power, rivaling that of cosmic beings like angels, demons, Shecknurd, Olerta, Jonun, Angels of Destiny, and the Domi Mages.

name: Iota Rank
description: Eight level of power, this level is rare and extremely powerful. At this level someone could control galaxies to an extent of possibly destroying or creating them. Only a handful of beings exists that can do that of which includes the Primordial Ones and Belki.

name: Kappa Rank
description: Ninth level of power, the Ho’zares are at this level of power, just below that of GOD. Also at this level are the Leviathans, Belckus, and the Akuma.

name: Sigma Rank
description: The level of GOD, Chaos, The Neither, and the Misikune Egg. This level is strong enough to create or erase universes at will.

name: Omega Rank
description: The eleventh level of power, this is the highest known rank of power as told in the Grand Thought. This power level can create and destroy all of existence. Only beings existing at this level are Anka and Elshack.

name: Magical Tomes
description: Powerful items created for various purposes including enclosing magic into objects. Every mage has a totem including spell books for spellcasters, wands for wizards, magical staffs for sorcerers, etc. Totems are created when the mage comes of age and are an extension of the particular mage’s magical essence.

name: Seven Totems of the Domi
description: Seven powerful items crafted by the Domi Mages to contain the magic that flowed throughout the Magical Community. One of these totems is the Book of Sanctuary held by the Lazarons.

name: Guides
description: High ranking Aurelians that appears not to age however many of them are usually hundreds to thousands of years old. They are guides and leaders of Guardians and Destroyers and in order to ascend from their current lives they must help their chosen protectors complete their require tasks.

name: Spell Creature
description: Another term for the creatures found throughout Aurelia. They are bound by the lands of Aurelia thanks to the spell from the Domi Mages. However, many including Monster Gods and highly evolved creatures can transcend space and even time to cross dimensions. Some creatures can evolve into numerous levels with a rare few that can ascend to Godly level. A select few can merge with their partners usually Aurelian or human partners through special bonds, while others can use technology to advance their own abilities and forms. Some can use magic to enhance their status and become special forms. Spell Creatures each can connect to an Armor Spell Card to become a special armored version of themselves, usually represented with armor on their normal forms with the word “armor” in front of their names. Spell Creatures can also speak with a few unable to form words so they just speak in variations like only repeating their names or making sounds similar to animals of which they resemble.

name: Aqua
description: This type usually live in the water, however some creatures live above grounds. Members of this type usually have fish like qualities and can control the substances of water.

name: Pyro
description: This type usually lives in hot or warm climates with little exception. Creatures of this type have small portions of fire related appearances either with flames or hot like bodies and can control the substance of fire & temperatures around them. Rarely this type can control smoke or gases around them.

name: Aqua
description: This type usually live in the water, however some creatures live above grounds. Members of this type usually have fish like qualities and can control the substances of water.

name: GEO
description: This type of creatures can control the earth beneath them. They usually have rock like bodies and usually are brute creatures that have hard exteriors. Most creatures live in rocky areas like caves & mountains.

name: Aero
description: Most creatures of this type can control the air, some can admit storms, others can just fly and use wind like attacks. Most creatures of this type are known to fly white others float on objects or control the weather.

name: GEO
description: This type of creatures can control the earth beneath them. They usually have rock like bodies and usually are brute creatures that have hard exteriors. Most creatures live in rocky areas like caves & mountains.

name: Metal
description: Creatures of this type are usually steel or metal skinned creatures, while others can control computers & appears mechanical.

name: Leaf
description: This type is known to be the friendliest of other creatures because of their links to nature. Most creatures are in tuned with nature and possess abilities to control nature like trees and even nearby water.

name: Metal
description: Creatures of this type are usually steel or metal skinned creatures, while others can control computers & appears mechanical.

name: Shock
description: This type a thousand years ago was the most feared of all types because of its wrathful attacks. Some believe this type to be descendants of the original Aero types because of their weather like attacks. Most creatures have symbols of thunderbolts around their bodies and can control electricity & thunder like attacks.

name: Elemental
description: One of the most powerful types, this type of creatures is known to be able to control Water, Earth, Fire, Wind, Weather, Metal, and surrounding nature. The very first creature in existence was this type and laid eggs that were the first Aqua, Pyro, Geo, Metal, and Leaf, Aero, & Beast types.

name: Shock
description: This type a thousand years ago was the most feared of all types because of its wrathful attacks. Some believe this type to be descendants of the original Aero types because of their weather like attacks. Most creatures have symbols of thunderbolts around their bodies and can control electricity & thunder like attacks.

name: Vermin
description: Often called children of the Leaf types, these creatures are mostly bug related and often have acid like attacks. Mostly they live in nature while others are known to live in rocky terrains.

name: Frozen
description: These creatures are often considered a mixture between Aqua & Geo type because of their often water and rock based attacks. Most creatures of this type can learn their parenting types and lives somewhere where its mostly cold climate.

name: Vermin
description: Often called children of the Leaf types, these creatures are mostly bug related and often have acid like attacks. Mostly they live in nature while others are known to live in rocky terrains.

name: Light
description: These creatures are one of the most powerful beings on the planets. They contain abilities sent from Heaven and are often considered to be angelic species instead of actual creatures. Most of their attacks are light based and are rarely seen using other type of attacks.

name: Often
description: The opposite of Light Types, these creatures are mostly ill tempered and most of them lives amongst the shadows or in the Dark Worlds which appear opposite to Aurelia. Most creatures that ascended in this type go to Hell and serve under Lord Behemoth the most powerful of Shadow Types.

name: Light
description: These creatures are one of the most powerful beings on the planets. They contain abilities sent from Heaven and are often considered to be angelic species instead of actual creatures. Most of their attacks are light based and are rarely seen using other type of attacks.

name: Prehistoric
description: Ancient creatures that resemble dinosaurs and sometimes actual animals with little similarities to other monsters. These type creatures are rare in Aurelia and often are found in the Ancient Realms which hovers above Aurelia. These creatures can learn various of other attacks such as Pyro, Aqua, Geo, and Leaf based.

name: Beast
description: Mostly resembling animals, Beast Types are known for their brute attacks and often monstrous nature. This type often uses physical attacks and is some of the most predatorily of all other types.

name: Prehistoric
description: Ancient creatures that resemble dinosaurs and sometimes actual animals with little similarities to other monsters. These type creatures are rare in Aurelia and often are found in the Ancient Realms which hovers above Aurelia. These creatures can learn various of other attacks such as Pyro, Aqua, Geo, and Leaf based.

name: Spirit
description: This type is the most feared and are rarely seen in this realm. These creatures if appearing in this realm appears mostly skeleton, ghostly, or transparent while in their own realm appears as they once did while alive. All creatures who dies becomes a Death type with their original types as a secondary type.

name: Soldier
description: Soldier Types are powerful creatures that mostly resemble humans. They are mostly elfish beings with body armor and mostly seen with weapons. Often considered Aurelians with magical abilities, they are actually creatures who over time have learned to change their images to match those they protect. Most attacks are physical.

name: Spirit
description: This type is the most feared and are rarely seen in this realm. These creatures if appearing in this realm appears mostly skeleton, ghostly, or transparent while in their own realm appears as they once did while alive. All creatures who dies becomes a Death type with their original types as a secondary type.

name: Spell
description: Spell types are one of the most powerful beings in all existences. They can easily travel through realms, summon powerful spells, and project their thoughts into reality. They are rarely captured like their peers and often act as their own partners.

name: Mind
description: Creatures with the most powerful mental stats. These types are often the most sought out of all types because of their rare abilities. Unlike most other types most creatures who have secondary abilities of a Mind type often can’t learn all Mind type attacks like Telepathy and Telekinesis.

name: Magic
description: Spell types are one of the most powerful beings in all existences. They can easily travel through realms, summon powerful spells, and project their thoughts into reality. They are rarely captured like their peers and often act as their own partners.

name: Bio-Hybrid
description: Powerful Bio-hybrid creatures that exists in the distant future. Most to all creatures of this species aren’t found in the present unless arriving through a vortex that can travel through time like the ones listed. It is stated that there are over 153 creatures that exist of this type with only 8 appearing so far.

name: Time
description: Powerful creatures that can control various portions of time. They wield special abilities that can protect them from mind control and from magic.

name: TOY
description: Creatures constructed through various methods with the most common being magic and technology. These creatures could be of various sizes and usually have physical attacks.

name: Monster Gods
description: Powerful deities that resides at the highest of various points throughout Aurelia. They are considered gods because of their advance levels, skills, knowledge, and they usually are immune from various abilities. They are known to be immortal, legendary status, and to possess no weaknesses.

name: Aura Beasts
description: Mirror like creatures that are direct opposites of the creatures and gods found in Aurealia. Markings around their bodies showcase their inner aura and when touch, it could release great power. Unlike their Aurelian counterparts, these creatures are only able to be caught by those also from their world, Aru. Each creature has a different marking around their bodies symbolizing the date of their birth as each creature was believed to have been born/created at separate times.

name: Night
description: Creatures of the night, this type’s abilities manifest mostly in the absence of the sun however can be used in daylight with little effect.

name: Day
description: Creatures of the daytime, although their abilities to redirect sunlight and to some extent use light-based attacks. This type is associated with the ancient Sun Gods and how its power comes directly from the sun, thus making them stronger in the daytime as oppose to nighttime.

name: Aura Beasts
description: Appearing like reflections of normal Spell Creatures, Aura Beasts are glowing creatures with markings representing their alternative world. When Aurelia was created, numerous particles formed from its creation and formed a mirror world where the god, Tonik rules. He has turned this world into a place of war and anger with little to desire. However, not all lifeforms here are evil and most creatures are direct counterparts to their respective forms in Aurelia. So if a creature is good in Aurelia then they are evil in the Aura realm, likewise the other way around.

name: Destroyers
description: Aurelians who like Guardians are often very skilled with vast magical abilities and knowledge. Opposites of Guardians, Destroyers are often considered children of black magic and can (for the most part) control the negative energy around them. Most content speak of Destroyers being more powerful in magic than their counterparts because of their carelessness of using magic to its extent.

name: Guardians
description: Aurelians with vast magical abilities and knowledge. They are often considered powerful entities which existed throughout time as protectors of the Royal Family and later all of Aurelia. Their abilities get stronger by each generation and are often teenagers whose destinies aren’t completed until the world is saved from their destined villain.

name: Battlers
description: Aurelians with limited magical abilities that are used to travel Aurelia in hopes of becoming stronger often sought out by battling and through special events to show their competitive natures. Most Battlers are often considered young Wizards however few can perform magic outside of their Spell Cards and Seals.

name: Aurelians
description: Elf people of Aurelia, often with similar appearances of humans however with a wider range of intelligence. They are often considered the ancestors of humanity and are considered grandparents on Earth in some tribes.

name: Grand Scheme
description: The large overlapping multiverse that combines several separate multiverses together through a grid of energy.

name: The Grand Design
description: A law or practice that everything must have a purpose and balance. If this balance and/or purpose is disturbed then both the forces of Fate, Good, and Evil will align to defeat the thing or person that disturbed the Grand Design. This law was created by The Neither.

name: Universal Energy Grid
description:
Note: UEG

Is a grid that flows through the multiverse connected every universe together. Every universe within the Grand Scheme is connected, with beliefs that it extends throughout the Omniverse. This flow of energy allows everything to exists on the same parallel timeline. If the Universal Energy Grid is disturbed, then it could cause the multiverse to start to fall apart. One of the attempts by the Akuma and its children were to destroy the grid.

name: The Veil
description: A massively thin shroud that separates the supernatural worlds from the world of mortals. It can only be seen by certain individuals. When the Akuma began eating away at the cosmos at the end of Chapter 1, the Veil began to break apart causing humans to see and interact with the supernatural world for the first time.

name: Avatars
description: Are spiritual forms that can also be physical beings with similar patterns, personalities, appearances, and emotional features as the original being that created them. Often powerful beings create avatars to exist and/or carry out a goal beyond their physical lifespan. All three of the creational trio Chaos, GOD, and The Neither have avatars that took on their own personalities, actions, directives, and abilities. Lesser gods like Khani are known for their powerful and sometimes destructive avatars appearing throughout history.

name: Hunters
description: Humanoid soldiers that are immune to magic and possesses a level of physical abilities. Abilities range from heightened senses, longevity, enhanced strength, speed, and many like Slayers can learn almost any physical activity.

name: Hunters
description: The primary race of humanoid soldiers that are descendants from the original hunter.

name: Dragon Warriors
description: Hunters who have dragon blood in their veins allowing them to grow dragon wings and breathe fire.

name: Slayers
description: Powerful soldiers that appear only one at a time in a generation and have all the abilities of a hunter including sensing where vampires are located.

name: Werewolf Hunters
description: Like Slayers, are powerful soldiers that appears only one at a time in a generation and appears with abilities of the hunter including enhanced senses of where werewolves are located.

name: Ghosthunters
description: Half hunters, half humans that possesses the abilities to capture ghosts and spirits. They can also enter the afterlife.

name: Mirror Cops
description: Glass like soldiers from the Mirror Realm that are slow but has enhanced strength.

name: Vengers
description: Possessing super speed and quick senses. They are quick to think and appear almost like creatures of the shadows. They also are capable of hearing and speaking to shadows.

name: Grand Thought
description: A term resulting from the unspeakable but understood form of communication from Elshack. Only the Neither can understand this, and it uses this form of communication to record all things mentioned from Elshack. These thoughts are recorded in a tome existing somewhere in the realm Eternity. Metatron provides the words of GOD in the form of the Grand Thought and has filled thousands of stone tablets with these words and placed them across time. Jesus also spoke the Grand Thought from GOD during his time on Earth. Psychics also have some connection to the Grand Thought although only through various versions of visions and touch.

name: Personification
description: A powerful form of connecting, linking, and distributing one’s status, form, name, person, and power to something else. For instance, a god could personify themselves to an object, feeling, time, etc. to exist forever if that thing exists. This was mentioned when Shecknurd mentioned how he could not die until Time itself was gone. Jessana also mentioned how she survived Mostibik was because she cannot die if there is love on Earth. Some personifications happen almost immediately upon clarifying them and others may take varying times. Also, it’s worth mentioned that Personification has no set limit, it can be limited to one place or all things.

name: Ascension and Descension
description: Ascension is one being meets the qualification to become a higher being. Descension is the opposite where a being can be demoted for failing a particular reason or law.

name: Example is
description:
Humans can ascend to become angels if their hearts are pure, or descend to become demons if their hearts are filled with distrust, hate, anger, etc.

Powerful gods like Shecknurd can ascend to Primordial One status once they have served their post for a set amount of time, same for Olerta and Jonun. Thus, the reason for Kain Lazaron taking over Shecknurd’s place as the new God of Time.

GOD, the Neither, or CHAOS could ascend to become the new First Light or Elshack once they are the last of the Creation Trio. This was mentioned briefly by Chaos upon its return to battle and defeat its siblings.

name: Magical Currency
description:
Note: MC

Usable currency used throughout the Magical Communities. Magical Currencies are determined by how powerful the individual containing the currency is. For example, a mage that is very powerful could have millions or billions worth of MC because of how strong they are. For children or lower ranked mages, their currencies could be as low as a few MCs to a few thousand MCs. Currencies are used to purchase many magical items, showcase wealth, buy properties, etc like mortal currency.

name: 1 Micro MC
description: 1 penny

name: Mage Guards
description: Protective armor that can appear as the mage wishes. Like a Mages’ totem, these garments can protect the wearer against almost all human created weapons and basic magic.

name: Dimensional Travelers
description: A term related to individuals or teams that travels between the various dimensions. More advance travelers can even travel between Dimensional Planes albeit vary rare. Because of their travels, they often befriend Dimension Guards and wear special ranked uniforms to allow for travel. Typically travelers are employed by different companies even a few by human based secret organizations.

name: Astrals
description: Beings consisting entirely of energy without corporal forms.

name: Spirits
description: Guides and sometimes teachers of the living. Unlike ghosts, they can freely come and go between the Realm of the Living to the Astral Plane.

name: Ghosts
description: The remaining energy of someone’s soul that gets trapped in a place where their death has happened. Sometimes when a ghost stays in the Realm of the Living pass their Life Date, they can gain supernatural abilities.

name: Ghouls
description: Powerful spirits that take various forms from little children to old hags. They usually have a green glow around themselves and are the evil counterparts to Spirits in that they are an evolution of a ghost but instead of helping the living they trick them into evil deeds.

name: Poltergeist
description: Powerful spirits that are capable of directly harming living beings. A ghost can only get to this level if they have had a traumatic death and have been either a Spirit or Ghoul.

name: Wraith
description: The most powerful Astral being there is, they can take many forms however usually appear almost skeletal with large flowing cloaks that if touch can kill anything including gods upon touch. Their exact beginnings are unknown, but they appear when a great disaster is about to happen. They appear moments before the Akuma began to destroy the cosmos.

name: Telekinesis
description:
Type: Ability
User: All types of Mages

Telekinesis is the ability to move objects with one’s mind. It is a common ability that most mages can do with ease. Kendo Lazaron is one of the most powerful mages capable of using it.

name: Telepathy
description:
Type: Ability
User: Telepaths

Capability to read someone’s mind. This ability doesn’t always work if someone has learned Mind Blocking.

name: Mind Blocking
description:
Type: Ability
User: All types of Mages

A basic form of magic that allows someone to block others from reading their mind. Depending on how skilled the Telepath is, this may not be effective.

name: Empathy
description:
Type: Ability
User: Empaths

A powerful ability capable of reading someone’s emotions. A popular ability mostly used by Druids, however Kendo Lazaron learned it and is extremely skilled at it.

name: Pyrokinesis
description:
Type: Ability
User: Elementals

The ability to control fire at will. Firestarters were powerful Elementals capable of controlling a great deal of fire. Khaun Lazaron, son of Kendo Lazaron is a Firestarter cable of controlling heat around him at will.

name: Power of Thought
description:
Type: Ability
User: Djins

Power of Thought is a powerful ability and common with Djins. It is the ability to be able to bring anything into existence with a thought.

name: Illustrative Thought
description:
Type: Ability
User: Djins & Witches

Illustrative Thought is a sub-ability to Power of Thought. The user can bring drawings to life.

name: Projection
description:
Type: Ability
User: Djins

A powerful ability and sub-ability to Power of Thought. This allows the user to bring forth anything they can think of. Because of the level of concentration, this ability is only permanent if the user can continue to concentrate on it.

name: Blood Magic
description:
Type: Ability
User: Witch

A powerful type of magic developed by witches during the rise of Tonik’s followers. This ability is dangerous as it allows the user to amplify their power and bring anything into existence with their blood. It was outlawed because using this power can also kill the user the longer, they perform it.

name: Shadow Magic
description:
Type: Ability
User: Shadow Creatures, Djins, Witches, & Shadow Fiend

Typically seen as a dark form of magic, but shadow magic is neutral in its natural form. The ability to control shadows, even as far as turning shadows into physical weapons. However, this ability while neutral is descendant from the Shadow Fiend. It was used by the Shadow Fiend to send multiple worlds into the Dark Ages and caused the beginning of the Dark War.

name: Virtual Reality Bending
description:
Type: Ability
User: Witch, Djin, Gods

Virtual Reality Bending is a rare ability that allows someone to create virtual realities at will. It also allows them to control that reality like a GOD.

name: Shapeshifting
description:
Type: Ability & Spell
User: Changlings, Shapeshifters, Gods, Witches, Djins, Fairies, Sorcerers, Wizards

Capable of allowing someone to change their appearance.

name: As a spell
description: For those that can’t naturally perform this ability. Spells like the Changling Spell used by witches can perform similar transformations.

name: Flight
description:
Type: Ability
User: All types of mages & descendants

Flight is a basic ability for mages. Typically someone would have to use magic to control their body while moving through the sky. Many descendants have this ability with no known affect needed for it to work.

name: Synthekinesis
description:
Type: Ability
User: All types of mages & descendants

Synthekinesis is the ability to control light. Rather the user just redirects the light, emits the light from their body or somewhere else, or through other means. This ability is common with Elementals.

name: Aquakinesis
description:
Type: Ability
User: Elementals

The ability to control water, some users can turn their entire body to liquid and others can create water out of various things and objects. Kara Lazaron & Aqua are two of the most powerful users of this ability.

name: Geokinesis
description:
Type: Ability
User: Elementals & Gods

Geokinesis is the ability to control the earth. Popularized by the Earth God Tur and Elementals.

name: Aerokinesis
description:
Type: Ability
User: Elementals

Aerokinesis is another elemental ability allowing the control of the air, wind, and usually users have the gift of flight.

name: Hovering
description:
Type: Ability
User: All types of Mages and Descendants

Sub-ability to flight, hovering allows the user to hover above the ground or surface. A common ability and can often be done through meditation or the use of extreme power.

name: Spirit Magic
description:
Type: Ability
User: All types of Mages and Descendants

Forbidden magic unless stated by a high authority’s figure. Spirit magic allows the user a great deal control over spirits and to be able to intervene into the spirit world. Spirit Woman, spirits, ghosts, and Necromancers are users of this ability.

name: Necromancing
description:
Type: Ability
User: Soul Man, Gods of the Underworld

Ability to control the dead and bring someone back from the dead. Forbidden magic that can cause someone to face death or be greatly punished by the Gods of the Underworld and High Council. Soul Man used the Pearl of Indomnia to control the dead in an alternate universe. He was punished and his power was given back to the gods.

name: Common Abilities
description:
Type: Ability
User: Varies

These abilities are very common and are usually found amongst descendants:

name: Lazer Eyes
description: Ability to shoot lazers from your eyes.

name: Enhanced Touch
description: The ability to feel every little thing on an object.

name: Enhanced Hearing
description: Also called Sonic Hearing, is the ability to hear great distances and in detail.

name: Common Magic
description:
Type: Ability
User: Varies

These abilities are very common amongst mages:

name: Sensing
description: Allows the user to sense other physical beings around them.

name: Potion Making
description: Basic spell casting without the use of direct magic.

name: Floating
description: Like hovering but allows someone to move in various ways.

name: Spell Casting
description: A common ability by many mages. It can range from basic potion making to powerful spells.

name: Soul Swapping
description:
Type: Spell
User: Witches & Wizards

A rare and dangerous spell that allows the caster to swap souls with someone or something else. If the spell can’t reverse, then it becomes permanent after 24 hours.

name: Mostibik
description:
Age: Lasted 14 days
Cause: Fall of the gods and Valkens

An event predicted during the birth of the gods, that all gods would fall in an epic battle between Gods and Valkens. This event caused the world to forget about the existence of the gods, their home was destroyed.

name: Dominion Fall
description:
Age: 7 days
Cause: Tonik’s betrayal against the Domi Mages

Tonik betrayed his brethren to gain most power from the flowing cosmic source of energy. He created shadow creatures and battled with the other Domi Mages. Tonik at the end was defeated and then banished to a dark place later known as the Shadow Realm.

name: Dark Ages
description:
Age: 100 years
Cause: Tonik attempt to overthrow all magic

Tonik returned thousands of years after his banishment although in a weakened state. At this moment he created another army of loyal followers. He created dragons, Sholls, and other shadow creatures in the process and collectively started what would become the Dark Ages across numerous worlds. This war resulted in the creation of the High Council and the Royal Family of magic.

name: Dark War
description:
Age: 20 years
Cause: Hunters attack on Mages

At the end of the Dark Ages, the Hunters saw how powerful the mages are and feared that they would grow too powerful. A group of hunters came together and brought forth a war against the mages to lessen their control over their world. In the fallout, magic ceased to work for days. During this time, the mages came up with Battle Magic, adopted technology from Earth, and learned basics like farming and cooking. At the end of the Dark War, the hunters were all but driven out of the Magical Community. To ensure magic would never face such grim times again.

name: Fracture Point
description:
Age: 4 days
Cause: Akuma eating universes

Fracture Point is a point in time where the Akuma caused the multiverse to blend. This event lasted for days before various magical and human beings stopped the comic entity.

name: Fixed Point
description:
Age: Random throughout time
Cause: To prevent time from being influenced

Fixed Point a moment in time where no one can prevent it from happening. This moment is scattered throughout history and created by Shecknurd and the Arcota as pivotal moments that can change the direction and flow of time in unmanageable ways.

name: End of Time
description:
Age: Unknown
Cause: Time starts over

One of the most feared and important moments in time. This marks the end of the universe and is predicted to come when many stars have died out. Although the exact moment is unknown by everyone except Shecknurd, The Neither, GOD, Chaos, Tonik, Kain Lazaron, Olerta, Jonun, The Groners, and the Angels of Destiny.

name: Anka and Elshack’s birth
description:
Age: Six hours
Cause: Anka is born and wakes up

During this moment before time, Anka awakens to perpetual darkness. It becomes aware of its existence and creates light to see. This light turns into Elshack.

This moment is the first moment ever in existence, as nothing existed before it. When it happens not even GOD, Chaos, Elshack, nor The Neither knows. It is believed that because of its age, not even Anka knows of when it was born.

name: War of Heaven Part One
description:
Age: Uknown
Cause: Chaos and God fight

Chaos growing frustrated with the noise and light that GOD creates, began destroying GOD’s creations. In a rage, the two fought birthing the Primordial Existence in the process. Chaos creates the Leviathans to overpower GOD, while GOD creates the Ho’zare and later the Akuma and wins the fight.

name: Birth of Evil
description:
Age: Throughout time
Cause: Chaos fall to Oblivion

As Chaos begins to fall to the dark nothingness of existence, its essence starts to spread and influence future beings born into existence including Belckus and Lucifer. This moment is the known as the Birth of Evil.

name: War of Heaven Part Two
description:
Age: 666 years
Cause: Belckus war against GOD

God creates the beautiful six-winged Primordial Ones and instructs them to fill the new universe with stars and planets. Furious of their attention from GOD, Belckus creates the Belki to show his own power to GOD, with GOD unknowingly unaware of the Belki, Belckus enraged starts a war against GOD and the newly formed Heaven. This leads to the second war of the Heavens. Belckus and the Belki are then sent to the lowest parts of existence and a cage later known as Hell is built around them.

name: War of Heaven Part Three and Fall of Lucifer
description:
Age: 66 years
Cause: Lucifer war against Heaven

Like the fate of Belckus, the third war of the heavens was caused by Lucifer and his battle against Heaven’s archangels. The reason was because of his growing jealousy of GOD’s affection of humans and the gifts presented these flawed creatures. After attempting humans to betray GOD’s commands countless time, GOD continued to give them chances. This enraged the young angel, the last Battle of Heaven ended when Lucifer was banished to Hell with his followers.

name: Afterworld Beginnings
description:
Age: WWIII lasted almost 10 years
Cause: Countries fighting against each other, killing billions

War World Three finally happens when all the countries of Earth fight nearly destroying everything on the planet. Those who remain takes sides as they divide the Earth even further. Old Worlders believe in the old ways, while the Supreme believe in technology and moving forward from the war.

name: Day of Retribution
description:
Age: One day each year
Cause: To lower crime rates

A once in a year event that allows anyone to take the life of someone else over the age of 18 without any consequences. It takes place in Universe 666 and has been called by many names by numerous residents. It started in 1908 and has since became a public date when governments started to sanction it. Because of this event, crimes across the world have decreased considerably, causing many to treat this day as a relief, vacation, and holiday. For some it is the world’s day to let out their worse desires.

name: Hallow’s Eve
description:
Age: Since the birth of time and later Olerta
Cause: Olerta one day of sleep

Hallow’s Eve is the true Halloween, it is the moment each year when the veil between the realms is weakened because it is the one day that Olerta is asleep. On this day, the dead can awake and roam the living world, Hell’s gates are open although demons are powerless, same for angels and spirits of all kinds. Spirits and ghosts can take corporal form in the Realm of the Living. While this day has greatly diminished over time with Olerta placing safeguards in fear of beings abusing this day. However, in numerous realities such as Universe 666, his event is a day of Hell on Earth.

name: Reverse Time Moment
description:
Age: Unknown
Cause: At the End of Time

A moment at the end of time when the new Elshack restarts existence and Shecknurd creates new Arcota from previously deceased living beings. During, this moment everything in existence except for Eden is destroyed and recreated to mark the rebirth of all things. Only Elshack remembers the previous creation of existence.

name: Dissolution
description:
Age: Year 1230
Cause: The need to enhance mages abilities

During the year 1230, Mages learned how to no longer need to carry their magical books with them everywhere again, thus allowing the Magical Community to grow stronger.

name: The Outbreak
description:
Age: 50 years
Cause: Shadow Realm overtakes the Earth

In the year 5943, 3000 years from current day, the Shadow Realm will spill onto Earth unleashing death and destruction. The advanced civilization of mankind is attempting to stop this invasion. However, humans failed, and the shadow creatures overtook Earth. In the process, nearly 7 billion people became zombies and other types of shadow creatures. During this time, Earth started to appear like how it did centuries prior.  This moment in time became the premise of the Rise of the Dead saga.

name: Society rebuilding on Earth
description:
Age: 300 years
Cause: Rebuilding Earth after WWIII

After WWIII, humans began to rebuild society. In the process the story of Afterworld unfolds. Old worlders started to rebuild on the ground creating a peaceful Utopia while New Worlders created cities in the sky.

name: Ancestors of the Lazarons
description: This coven primarily was focused on Europe and from them came a witch that created the first demon vanquishing spell. From them would birth four of the most powerful witches to have ever lived The Lazarons.

name: Ancestors of the Witch’s Council
description: This coven primarily based in South America was the creator of the first spell book and from them the first Witch’s Council.

name: Ancestors of Asian Witchcraft
description: This coven primarily focused on Asia was the first ones to integrate witchcraft with the power of the Asian deities.

name: Ancestors of the Charmed Ones
description: This coven was formed in North America and became the ancestors to the of the most powerful witches in history and from them came a twice blessed warlock powerful enough to destroy demons with one word.

name: Ancestors of the Hiltons
description:
Note: Ancestral Magic, Royal Family of Witches

This coven focused on Africa became the first royal family of witches and from them came ancestral magic and the formation of the Ancestral plane where witches went to lend their magic to their future descendants.

name: Ancestors of Wizards and Gypsies
description: This coven unlike the rest, not focused in one place. Became the ancestors to Gypsies and Wizards. From them came berserk magic and the first use of using magical items to direct their magic.
